standing_user_preferences: Serialize writers that share a checkout.
Long tests and executions must print progress; no silent buffered pipelines.
Never implement AIS-, file-, question-, provision- or data-specific fixes.
A negative claim needs direct evidence exactly like a positive one.
Before calling a test failure environmental, check ambient .env inheritance.
Do not commit, push, reset, stash, clean, switch branches or rewrite history without explicit authorization.
Never print or preserve secrets from .env, Key Vault, headers, logs, connection strings, tokens or generated subscription keys.
Do not run backend and both frontend suites concurrently (vitest worker startup timeouts from CPU contention).
No caching or memoization in the decision path.
The 10-minute scheduled oversight audit was explicitly stopped.
